purpose: Assign useful validation work to known nodes without changing payout status, moving private data, scanning third-party systems, or activating production failover.
value_boundary: Validation output values are operational ledger/readiness values only. They are not verified paid revenue, do not authorize payout, and do not promote payout status.
global_guardrails: No unauthorized scanning or traffic routing.
No payout or revenue status promotion from validation work alone.
No production failover activation without operator approval and health quorum.
Only test owned/public SKYGRID endpoints and local fixtures.
Log results as proof artifacts before promotion.
